title: Karaoke Night on Friday 18 September
preheader: Free entry, singing from 8pm. Reserve a place for everyone coming, singers and listeners alike.

data.heading: What are you singing first?
body: Join us for Big Sing Friday at The Anchor. Pick a solo, bring a duet partner or enjoy cheering everyone on. Peter will host a night of favourite songs and shared choruses.
Entry is free. Reserve a free place for everyone coming so we can prepare the communal seating. No online payment is taken.

image.alt: Karaoke Night singer using a microphone at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

rows.label: Songs
rows.value: Request your choice through the host

rows.label: Families
rows.value: All ages welcome; under-18s with a supervising adult

data.heading: Your song, your moment
body: Solos, duets, groups and happy listeners are all welcome. Song requests depend on the karaoke library and the time remaining.
Make an evening of it with dinner before the singing starts. Dinner is served from 4pm to 9pm.

data.body: Book your group together, then start choosing your first song.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
